topics.text: Features include spacious rooms with clean bedding, well-maintained pools, large lawns, children’s play areas (slides, playgrounds), KTV, and outdoor recreational spaces. The pool is regularly maintained and suitable for swimming and relaxation.

Staff are described as friendly, attentive, and helpful, providing recommendations for local attractions, prompt responses to requests, and assistance with luggage or emergencies. The overall service experience is positive and personalized.
Rooms and common areas are consistently praised for being clean, odor-free, and well-kept. Attention to detail in hygiene, such as high-quality hairdryers and sanitized facilities, is highlighted.

Breakfast options are varied and flavorful, featuring dishes like fried noodles, congee, pickled tofu, and homemade farm-style meals. The quality of food and local specialties (e.g., bamboo forest cuisine) is frequently commended.

address: No. 3, Xibei Village Group 9, Nanlu Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
